$description: Canyon dashboard tokens (W3C DTCG, hex-string draft, as Style Dictionary reads it). Values are the redesign's (#1401, proposal revision 2, approved 2026-10-02) in the getcanyon.ai landing page's brand (#2885): one colour per status, the indigo accent only for what you can act on. Every text token clears 4.5:1 on bg, surface and surface-2 in both sets, which validate.py checks; the figures are on each token. Light is the base set; dark is the OS-dark set. This file is NOT a registry item: it carries radius, type, shadow and motion, which the registry README keeps out of published themes. See README.md for the generator and the drift check.

light.$description: The light set, in the getcanyon.ai landing page's colours (#2885): its violet-greys, and its indigo as the accent. validate.py holds every text colour to 4.5:1 on bg, surface and surface-2 and on its own -dim fill, in both sets; the figures here are its output.

surface.$description: Cards, tables, the rail, panels, menus.

surface-2.$description: Table head, row hover, code excerpts, inset boxes. The landing's deep.

border.$description: Hairline between rows and around a box. The landing's border.

border-strong.$description: Control edges: inputs, buttons, segments. The landing's border2.

scrim.$description: Behind a dialog over the page: the page dimmed, so the question is the one thing to answer (#102).

text.$description: The landing's fg. 18.05:1 on surface · 16.25:1 on surface-2.

text-dim.$description: Secondary text. The landing's muted. 9.03:1 on surface · 8.12:1 on surface-2.

text-faint.$description: Meta: ages, table heads, captions. The landing's faint, darkened to clear AA. 5.67:1 on surface · 5.11:1 on surface-2.

accent.$description: Canyon indigo, the landing's: buttons, links and the selected page, nothing else. 5.04:1 on surface · 4.53:1 on surface-2.

accent-dim.$description: The selected rail item's fill. accent reads 4.52:1 on it.

link.$description: Alias. A link is indigo: something you can act on.

critical.$description: Blocked, failed, critical and high severity. 6.57:1 on surface.

critical-dim.$description: The blocked pill's fill. critical reads 5.79:1 on it.

amber.$description: Waiting, awaiting review, approved with an exception, medium severity. 5.47:1 on surface.

amber-dim.$description: The waiting pill's fill. amber reads 4.93:1 on it.

ok.$description: Passed, running, live. 5.02:1 on surface · 4.51:1 on surface-2.

ok-dim.$description: The passed pill's fill. ok reads 4.62:1 on it.

neutral.$description: Not checked, never reviewed, nothing uploaded, low severity. 6.21:1 on surface.

neutral-dim.$description: The neutral pill's fill. neutral reads 5.38:1 on it.

beta.$description: The Beta chip (EXPERIENCE.md D5, #2384): a feature that works but isn't complete or fully tested yet. Not a status, so a hue no status uses, and not the indigo accent: the landing's crimson, deepened. 6.32:1 on surface.

beta-dim.$description: The Beta chip's fill. beta reads 5.64:1 on it.

dark.$description: The dark set, under @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark). The landing has no dark mode: these are its violet-greys and indigo carried to a dark ground, which starts at its strong.

sans.$description: Self-hosted woff2, three weights. Everything that is not code or a title: at 13px in a dense table it reads clearer than the landing's Space Grotesk, whose I, l, 1 and | nearly merge.

display.$description: The landing page's face, self-hosted, semibold alone: page titles (every h1) and the wordmark.

mono.$description: The landing page's mono, self-hosted, three weights, its code ligatures (calt) cut so code reads as typed. Code only: snippets, commit hashes and terminal commands.

size.$description: Four sizes: 12, 13, 14 and 24px, and nothing on a screen under 12px. The other names alias the four until each screen's redesign PR (#1401) moves its classes onto them.

sm.$description: Small: pills, table heads, meta lines, captions.

md.$description: Secondary: sub-lines, descriptions, help under a control.

base.$description: Body: text, table cells, buttons, and section headings in semibold.

medium.$description: Table heads, banner emphasis, ghost buttons.

semibold.$description: The workhorse: names, titles, blocked and production stage words, tile numbers, the brand mark. There is deliberately no 700: the mockup's two bold declarations snap here, and 400/500/600 in Plex Sans and JetBrains Mono, with 600 alone in Space Grotesk, are the only faces the bundle ships. This file cannot prevent a component asking for 700 — Tailwind's own --font-weight-* and --color-* defaults survive @theme inline, so font-bold and bg-red-500 still resolve; the scaffold PR resets those namespaces to initial in its @theme. Until it does, font-bold renders a synthesised face.

tight.$description: URLs and big stage lines. mockup 1.25 and 1.3.

caps.$description: Every uppercase label. Collapses the mockup's 0.04 / 0.06 / 0.08 / 0.09 / 0.1; at 10px the widest gap is 0.4px per character.

radius.$description: Six steps plus a pill. The mockup's 5, 7 and 9 round to the nearest step (1px drift, 7 declarations).

sm.$description: Chips, rule-id pills, the focus ring.

md.$description: Chevrons, textareas. mockup 5 and 7 land here.

lg.$description: Buttons, selects, search, inset boxes, segmented controls.

xl.$description: Panels, tables, cards, findings, receipt, toast, inspector boxes. mockup 9 lands here.

full.$description: The Needs-you pill and status dots.

overlay.$description: Inspector, drawer, toast, floating button. The landing's strong at 12%.

ring-inset.$description: A pressed tile. Drawn in the accent by the component. Mode-independent.

motion.$description: Everything here is suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

instant.$description: Tile border on hover and press.

fast.$description: The promote button filling, and the activity rail rows fading in.

medium.$description: The receipt row flip (scale 1.02) and its colour change.

drawer.$description: Inspector and drawer slide from the right edge.

slow.$description: A finding dimming during re-review. D6: findings dim, they never disappear before the result is known.

unlock.$description: D6, the one carefully-built animation: the receipt row flips, then 160ms later the button fills. Cause visibly precedes effect. This number is load-bearing copy — EXPERIENCE.md states it and the app-detail mockup prints it on the page.

standard.$description: The mockup's only easing. One curve, everywhere.

flip.$description: The receipt row's scale at the top of the flip.

rail-in.$description: How far an activity row rises as it fades in.
